plugin-lifecycle.reason: No plugin load/teardown or IDA callbacks change; the RAX process backend remains behind its existing entry points.

UI-state.reason: No Qt widgets, ownership, rendering or copy changes.

conversation-lane.reason: No transcript, cancellation, lane or history implementation changes.

agent-backend.reason: Provider and orchestration code are unchanged; selected NT directory data is private to the process-emulation backend.

prompt-context.reason: No prompts, context collection or anonymization changes.

tool-schema.reason: Existing emulation options and result schemas remain unchanged; no new tool is registered.

permission-mutation.reason: Capture current-host directory grants and case policy without forwarding guest opens or creating host namespace objects. Guest handles continue to refer to private captured metadata.

main-thread-dispatch.reason: The Rust userland engine calls no IDA, Hex-Rays or Qt API.

mesh-MCP.reason: No routing, identity, discovery manifest or external protocol change.

transport-crypto.reason: No framing, credentials or cryptographic data changes.

persistence.reason: Captured properties are private to one process runtime; no persisted schema or path changes.

SDK-ABI.reason: The directory tree and completeness flag are internal Rust state. Exported C layouts, signatures and ABI versions are unchanged.

optional-engines.reason: RAX installed Windows runtime gains BaseNamedObjects and selected-session ancestry. Other engines are unchanged.

update-release.reason: After complete validation, publish a separate RAX semantic group and paired root pin/engineering records through the authorized workflow. No release notes, defaults or package layout changes.

targets-platforms.reason: Portable Rust selection/tree/probe-policy code and service tests require macOS, Linux and Windows validation. Native acquisition and independent installed-leaf checks run on Windows. C API/retained Assist consumers and packaging are audited separately; no public ABI or installed-file layout is changed.

tests-docs.reason: Native access/coherence evidence, direct and installed-leaf tests, full three-host core checks and retained-consumer scope are bound in validation/.

direct-decode.reason: No instruction decoder or encoding changes.

direct-execute.reason: Existing CPU execution and syscall ABI dispatch are unchanged; only selected process objects change.

cpu-state.reason: No register, exception, exported CPU-state or serialization layout changes.

memory-mmu.reason: No guest address-space, memory-probe, page permission, atomic or MMU implementation changes.

smir-lift.reason: No lifter changes or new instruction admission.

smir-ir.reason: No IR operation or type changes.

optimizer.reason: No IR transformation or optimization changes.

native-lowering.reason: No host emitter or lowering changes.

jit-runtime.reason: No JIT gate, trampoline, clobber, cache or exit changes.

backend.reason: KVM/HVF and software CPU adapters are unchanged.

machine-device.reason: No board, device, MMIO, PIO or DMA changes.

oracle-analysis.reason: No static oracle schema or architectural effect model changes.

c-abi.reason: Only private Rust namespace state and native selection wiring change; exported C headers/layouts/functions remain unchanged.

user-mode-runtime.reason: Installed Windows directory capture, selected-session tree assembly and object-open metadata/lifetime contracts.

tests-docs.reason: Native input/identity/coherence evidence, direct service and installed-leaf tests, three-host full-core and C API/consumer gates.

partial-membership.reason: Directory completeness is private state; incomplete membership cannot prove object absence. No public ABI changes.
